features: 5-in-1 XVR: AHD/TVI/CVI/CVBS analog inputs plus IP cameras
Recording rate, analog channels: 5MP Lite 10fps; 4MP Lite/1080P 12fps (PAL)/15fps (NTSC); 1080P Lite/720P/WD1 25fps (PAL)/30fps (NTSC)
Recording rate, IP cameras: main stream 5MP/4MP/3MP/1080P/960P/720P/960H/D1/CIF (1~25/30fps); sub stream 1080P/960H/D1/CIF (1~25/30fps)
Video analytics (only with dedicated cameras); motion detection with AHD cameras
Integration protocols: ONVIF Profile G, T
Additional output per FR 2026 promo: 1 BNC (CVBS, spot monitor); not listed in the IT 2024 catalogue
AHDVR008N05ASL is the version without HDD; AHDVR008N05A includes a 1TB HDD
Conflict: max HDD capacity stated as 10TB (IT 2024 catalogue) vs 8TB (FR 2026 promo); omitted
Compatible metal boxes: SBOX, LBOX (with monitor)
